sub_agendas_items.title: Designation of the Crabtree House, 559 Lang’s Road under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act

attachments.attachment_title: 4.1 Document 5 - Statement of Cultural Heritage Value.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes: Dawn Chan, Heritage Planning Intern, Heritage Planning Branch, presented an overview of the report recommendations and answered questions from the Committee.  Lesley Collins, Program Manager, was also available to answer questions. A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.Committee Members received a written submission from David Flemming, Heritage Ottawa, in support of the application, and a copy is filed with the Office of the City Clerk:Pauline van der Roest spoke before the Committee in support the report recommendations.Following discussion on this item, the Committee carried the report recommendations as amended by motion no BHC 2023-03-01.

motions.motion_text:
Report recommendation
That the Built Heritage Committee recommend that Council issue a Notice of Intention to Designate the Crabtree House, 559 Lang’s Road, under Part IV of theOntario Heritage Act, according to the Statement of Cultural Heritage Value, attached as Document 5.

WHEREAS the City of Ottawa has not yet undertaken a comprehensive inventory and evaluation of Ottawa’s “mid-century modern” architecture; and,
WHEREAS the classification of buildings constructed in the “mid-century modern” period cannot be classed as “unique” or “excellent” examples until a comprehensive inventory of their contemporaries has been systematically completed.
WHEREAS in the interim, the use of the term “representative” should be used as permitted in Ontario Regulation 09/06;
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Statement of Cultural Heritage Value listed as Document 5 of this report be amended as follows:
“The Crabtree House has design value as an excellent example of modernist residential architecture in Ottawa”be replaced with“The Crabtree House has design value as arepresentativeexample of modernist residential architecture in Ottawa.”

motions.motion_text:
Report recommendations
That the Built Heritage Committee and the Planning and Housing Committee recommend that Council:

WHEREAS with respect to report ACS2023-PRE-RHU-0006, a request for deferral has come forward in order to align with the timing of the associated Zoning By-law amendment report for Planning and Housing Committee; and
WHEREAS the applicant has agreed to an extension of the statutory timeline under the Ontario Heritage Act to align the timing of the applications.
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED THAT, with respect to report ACS2023-PRE-RHU-0006, Built Heritage Committee approve the deferral of the report indefinitely until the associated Zoning By-law amendment report is scheduled to rise to Planning and Housing Committee at a yet to be determined date.
